card.line: Bochim, meaning "weepers," is a place west of the Jordan, above Gilgal, where Israel wept after the angel of the LORD rebuked them for disobeying.

moments.title: The angel's rebuke
moments.text: The angel of the LORD went up from Gilgal to Bochim. He said Israel had not obeyed God's voice, so God would no longer drive out the people of the land.

moments.title: Israel weeps and sacrifices
moments.text: When the angel finished speaking, all the people lifted up their voices and wept. They named the place Bochim and offered sacrifices there to the LORD.
